_comment: UK English strings. No gambling vocabulary anywhere — use stake/commitment/pledge/forfeit.

AuthButton.step1: Get World App — it's a free app, like any other.
AuthButton.step2: Open World App and tap the QR scanner on the main tab, then point it at this code.
AuthButton.step3: DoomTax opens inside World App. Tap Connect — it signs one message to say it's you. Nothing is charged, nothing moves. DoomTax sets up your session account automatically — nothing else to connect.
AuthButton.step4: Runs on Hedera testnet — stakes carry no real-world money today.

StakeForm.description: Write it like a promise to yourself. Your AI coach reads these exact words when judging your proof — be specific enough that the verdict is clear.
StakeForm.placeholderIntention: Finish the settlement agent and get one payout working end to end
StakeForm.tooShort: Say a little more about the work.
StakeForm.qualityHint: Good intentions are checkable: name the thing and when it counts as done.
StakeForm.sessionInfo: Your {stakeHbar} ℏ is held on Hedera testnet for {duration}. Keep the commitment and it returns in full. Slip and it goes to the shared cause, never to us. You can disarm the session at any point before it settles.

ArtifactForm.heading: Show your work
ArtifactForm.placeholderArtifact: Paste what you produced, or describe what you finished and where it lives.
ArtifactForm.coachReceivesIntention: Your intention and the text above
ArtifactForm.coachNeverReceivesAttachment: Your attachment — it never leaves this phone (yet)
ArtifactForm.coachPrivacy: Never your screen, your browsing, your keystrokes, or anything from other apps.
ArtifactForm.coachReadingBody: Running privately on 0G, then settling on Hedera. This takes a moment.
ArtifactForm.attachButton: Attach a photo of your work — optional
ArtifactForm.attachCaption: Stays on your device. A fingerprint (hash) is computed locally so a future version can verify it on-chain. OCR reading on 0G is coming — today the coach judges your text only.

Verdict.publicReceiptDetail: Carries a commitment hash and the verdict only. Never your intention or your artifact.
Verdict.whatLedgerLabel: What goes on the public ledger

ConfirmSheet.title: Disarm this session?
ConfirmSheet.body: Your {stakeHbar} ℏ returns to you in full and nothing is forfeited. The session ends now and is not sent to your coach. Use this when the plan genuinely changed, not as a habit.

CirclePanel.impactDetail: {count} forfeits funded this cause. No leaderboard, no individual totals, and never a callout of who slipped.
CirclePanel.pendingForfeit: If this session stands, {hbar} HBAR joins your circle's total after the appeal window. The good still counts, but your name does not go with it.
CirclePanel.private: Your circle stays private. We show what you have funded together, not a list of members — and never who slipped.

About.heroTitle: A kinder way to turn intention into follow-through
About.heroBody: DoomTax is a focus tool grounded in commitment-device research from behavioural economics. You name one task, put a small stake behind it, and get an honest verdict at the end.
About.gettingInBody: DoomTax runs as a mini app inside World App. Use the QR code below to open it on your phone.
About.readyBody: Start with a small stake. The research is clear that the size matters less than making the commitment real — pick something you genuinely intend to finish in the next session.
